the [[File:Yasuo NightbringerCircle.png|20xpx|link=Yasuo/Cosmetics|An icon representing Yasuo's Nightbringer skin in League of Legends]] [[Yasuo/Cosmetics|Nightbringer Yasuo]] skin, these shifts in
